killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) keeps the notices untitled, so the Legal page heads them with their own label
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is generated, not hand-edited matches what renderNotices() produces right now -- run `npm run notices` to fix
why: The defect #771's first render shipped past 6194 green tests and was seen only in a screenshot: the Legal page takes a document's first H1 as its title, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md had none, so a vendored part rendered as an H1 retitled the whole notices document "Vendored source" and swallowed its own heading. The guard parses the rendered notices with the Legal page's own parser.
